Game Overview

In Mad Joker, the core idea is straightforward: dive into the chaotic streets with Mad Joker, where you orchestrate mayhem against oppressive enforcers in this pulse-pounding 2D adventure. Evade, shoot, and explore a city brimming with hidden secrets and shadowy foes as you embrace the unpredictable fight for dominance. Enjoy every frantic moment of madness!
